ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a coward who stood and fought
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} stood when it counted, more than once, and has lost the habit of running.

plain.li: When the shooting started my legs wanted to run. I told them no, and they listened.
I used to know every hiding place in the colony. I've forgotten half of them.

warm.li: The others were counting on me. That turned out to matter more than being scared.

cheerful.li: Stood my ground in the last fight and only shook afterward. That still counts.

gloomy.li: Running never saved anyone here. Standing did, sometimes.

cold.li: Flight was an inefficient reflex. I've trained it out.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: vengeful after a loss and an oath
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: After the loss and the oath that followed it, spite has taken root in {PAWN_nameDef}, and {PAWN_pronoun} can't bear a rival under the same roof.

plain.li: I remember every one of them. Every face, every name. I'm keeping a list.
Someone said I should let it go. I smiled and didn't answer.

warm.li: I loved them. That's why I can't forgive the ones who took them.

cheerful.li: I'm cheerful about most things. Not about them. Them, I'll see to.

gloomy.li: The anger is all that's left of them that I can hold on to.

cold.li: Debts are meant to be settled. I intend to settle mine.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: world weary after too many losses
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Too many years and too many hard seasons have worn {PAWN_nameDef} down. Bleak thoughts come easily to {PAWN_objective} now, and {PAWN_pronoun} is harder to get close to.

plain.li: Another season. The same work, the same worries. I'm tired in a way sleep doesn't fix.
Someone asked me what I hope for. I had to think about it, and I'm still thinking.

warm.li: I still care. I'm just tired of everything I care about being taken away.

blunt.li: I'm tired. Of all of it.

cheerful.li: I used to bounce back. These days I mostly just land.

gloomy.li: I've seen enough of this world for one life.

cold.li: I have stopped expecting the world to be worth the effort.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a rebel after the council let them down
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Broken promises and lost votes have taught {PAWN_nameDef} to take orders badly. These days {PAWN_pronoun} goes by {PAWN_possessive} own rules, and drags {PAWN_possessive} feet when pushed.

plain.li: The council says, and then I decide. That's the order of things now.
I heard the council out, every word. Then I did what I was going to do anyway.

warm.li: I'd do anything for the people here. Just don't call it an order.

blunt.li: They broke their word. I don't owe them mine.

cheerful.li: They can put me on whatever they like. I'll get to it gladly, in my own order.

gloomy.li: The council has promised me things before. I remember how that went.

cold.li: Authority here has proven unreliable. I'll defer to it only when it suits me.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a workaholic after seasons without rest
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: A year with hardly a break, and fine work to show for it, has left {PAWN_nameDef} unable to put a job down, even when {PAWN_pronoun} should rest.

plain.li: They called me to supper three times. I finished what I was doing first. It needed finishing.
Went to bed and lay there going over the work, wishing it were morning.

warm.li: The work is how I look after everyone. Stopping feels like letting them down.

cheerful.li: Worked all day and there's still a list for tomorrow. Lovely.

gloomy.li: If I stop, I'll have to think. So I don't stop.

cold.li: Breaks are an inefficiency I no longer indulge.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: craven no more after standing their ground
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: When the fighting came, {PAWN_nameDef} stayed, and then stayed again, and no longer bolts at the first sign of danger.

plain.li: When they came, I didn't run. I didn't even think about it until after.
My hands shook the whole time. I stayed anyway.

warm.li: I couldn't leave them out there alone. Not again.

cheerful.li: I held my ground with the others. I keep telling myself it was really me.

gloomy.li: There's nowhere to run to anyway. Might as well stand.

cold.li: Running made me a liability. I've corrected that.
